rounds.notes: 3批独立收敛到同一个separation判定bug(数学审核、代码审核、结构审核各自发现),是本轮质量信号最强的一处。§3扩展成真正的benchmark construction(补task/item specification、sampling frame、split/stratification);新增§5.8统计功效/样本量规划;evaluator ladder改多轴表;Q11修正0.75 vs 0.7778两种估计量混写;Q12修正'同分布≠不独立'的统计概念混淆。

runnable_code_check.headline: The Bradley-Terry separation-detection rewrite is independently verified with a scratch regression: reinstating the old pairwise-only logic against a 3-player non-separated graph reproduces the false positive, confirming the new strongly-connected-component check is a real fix, not just a renamed function.

summary: LLM Evaluation & Benchmarking cheat sheet (effort=max, ~878 lines, bilingual). First tutorial in this batch to demonstrate triple-independent convergence on the same bug: the Bradley-Terry complete-separation misjudgment was caught separately by the math-review, code-review, AND structure-review passes, each from a different angle — strong evidence it was a real defect rather than reviewer noise. Also demonstrates cross-model self-correction on drafting: the drafting subagent itself caught and fixed an accidentally-transitive (mislabeled) cyclic Bradley-Terry test dataset before handing off. Final verdict: SHIP after full fix + re-verification.
